class="brxe-block"><h2 id="brxe-jrqtez" class="brxe-heading underheadings">The ideal spot for a surfing holiday in Denmark</h2><div id="brxe-kmabqo" class="brxe-text"><p>Are you thinking of going on a surfing holiday in the waves of the North Sea? At Hvide Sande Camping, you’ll find the ideal base for your next surfing holiday in Denmark, with direct access to some of Denmark’s most popular surfing spots. </p> <p>We offer a peaceful setting that makes it easy to combine sport and relaxation in scenic surroundings right between the <a href="https://hvidesandecamping.dk/camping-vesterhavet/">North Sea</a> and Ringkøbing Fjord. There’s room here for both beginners in the fjord’s calmer waters and more experienced surfers in the ocean’s waves. </p> <p>So choose a surfing holiday at a <a href="https://hvidesandecamping.dk/campingplads-jylland/">campsite in Jutland</a>, where nature and the wind set the pace, and where you can get out onto the water quickly, whatever your level.</p> class="brxe-block"><h2 id="brxe-alopsq" class="brxe-heading underheadings">A surfing holiday with room for the whole family</h2><div id="brxe-qvpxma" class="brxe-text"><p>We ensure you get as much time on the board as possible during your surfing holiday by offering accommodation right next to some of the best surfing spots on the <a href="https://hvidesandecamping.dk/a-short-break-on-the-west-coast/?lang=en">Jutland west coast</a>. Among other things, we offer: </p> <ul> <li>Space for tents, caravans and large motorhomes</li> <li>Small, basic cabins for the simple life of surfers</li> <li>Large luxury cabins with modern comforts for the whole family</li> </ul> <p>Right opposite the campsite, you’ll also find <a href="https://westwind.dk/pages/course-page/surfkursus">Westwind Surf School,</a> which is the ideal neighbour for both beginners and experienced surfers. Here, the whole family can try their hand at surfing, as lessons are available for everyone over the age of 12. </p> <p>You don’t need to bring heavy equipment yourself, as you can easily hire everything you need on site. After your time in the water, you can use the handy outdoor showers at the campsite to rinse off the salt water before heading back to your cabin, tent or caravan. </p> </div><h2 id="brxe-ecfyzf" class="brxe-heading underheadings">Are you ready to book your next surfing holiday?</h2><div id="brxe-cwcsxp" class="brxe-text"><p>Then call us on <a href="tel:+4597311218">97 31 12 18</a>, send us an <a href="info@hvidesandecamping.dk">email</a>, fill in the <a href="https://hvidesandecamping.dk/contact/?lang=en">contact form</a> here on the site, or book a place directly through our <a href="https://v3.onlinebooking.dk/v3hvidesan" target="_blank" rel="noopener">online booking system</a>.</p> <p>We look forward to welcoming you to an active holiday in the heart of West Jutland. Whether you’re into action on the waves or relaxation by the fjord, we have a place for you. </p> </div><div id="brxe-ajocxs" class="brxe-block"><a id="brxe-rwkhmp" class="brxe-button bricks-button lg bricks-background-secondary" href="https://hvidesandecamping.dk/contact/?lang=en">Contact us</a><a id="brxe-tguuxn" class="brxe-button bricks-button lg bricks-background-primary" href="https://v3.onlinebooking.dk/v3hvidesan" target="_blank">Online booking</a></div></div></div></section><section id="brxe-ixrpmy" class="brxe-section FAQ-section-one"><div id="brxe-egplyb" class="brxe-container FAQ-section-one__container"><div id="brxe-wvjuvb" class="brxe-block FAQ-section-one__container-faq"><div id="brxe-xponnp" class="brxe-block FAQ-section-one__container-info"><div id="brxe-niblqo" class="brxe-block FAQ-section-one__inner-container-info"><h2 id="brxe-mpbgyz" class="brxe-heading FAQ-section-one__heading">FAQ</h2><div id="brxe-ibursr" class="brxe-text FAQ-section-one__description"><p>Find answers to frequently asked questions:</p> </div></div></div><div id="brxe-otgjdz" data-script-id="otgjdz" class="brxe-accordion-nested FAQ-section-one__accordion" data-script-args="expandFirstItem"><div id="brxe-xqfacv" class="brxe-block FAQ-section-one__item"><button id="brxe-ufiomz" class="brxe-block FAQ-section-one__question accordion-title-wrapper" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0" aria-controls="brxe-qrzdbg"><h3 id="brxe-hpkobx" class="brxe-heading FAQ-section-one__answer-heading">Is your campsite suitable for both beginners and experienced surfers?</h3><div id="brxe-cxsawc" class="brxe-div FAQ-section-one__answer-icon-wrapper"><i id="brxe-dsrsfh" class="fas fa-plus brxe-icon FAQ-section-one__answer-icon"></i></div></button><div id="brxe-qrzdbg" class="brxe-block FAQ-section-one__answer accordion-content-wrapper" role="region" aria-labelledby="brxe-hpkobx"><div id="brxe-qpvsuq" class="brxe-text FAQ-section-one__answer-content"><p>Yes, absolutely. We&rsquo;re beautifully situated right between the challenging waves of the North Sea and the calmer waters of Ringk&oslash;bing Fjord, making it the ideal spot whatever your level. </p> </div></div></div><div id="brxe-hnbldc" class="brxe-block FAQ-section-one__item"><button id="brxe-axepkz" class="brxe-block FAQ-section-one__question accordion-title-wrapper" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0" aria-controls="brxe-dxlkhj"><h3 id="brxe-xzzjjm" class="brxe-heading FAQ-section-one__answer-heading">Can I take surfing lessons near the campsite?</h3><div id="brxe-uoalpo" class="brxe-div FAQ-section-one__answer-icon-wrapper"><i id="brxe-knswmh" class="fas fa-plus brxe-icon FAQ-section-one__answer-icon"></i></div></button><div id="brxe-dxlkhj" class="brxe-block FAQ-section-one__answer accordion-content-wrapper" role="region" aria-labelledby="brxe-xzzjjm"><div id="brxe-iuidhe" class="brxe-text FAQ-section-one__answer-content"><p>Yes, our neighbour is Westwind Surf School. They offer lessons for anyone over the age of 12, so both children and adults can get started with the sport safely. </p> </div></div></div><div id="brxe-masbja" class="brxe-block FAQ-section-one__item"><button id="brxe-eukltu" class="brxe-block FAQ-section-one__question accordion-title-wrapper" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0" aria-controls="brxe-cwuhan"><h3 id="brxe-wdoafa" class="brxe-heading FAQ-section-one__answer-heading">What type of accommodation do you recommend for surfers?</h3><div id="brxe-fsfeyj" class="brxe-div FAQ-section-one__answer-icon-wrapper"><i id="brxe-snugge" class="fas fa-plus brxe-icon FAQ-section-one__answer-icon"></i></div></button><div id="brxe-cwuhan" class="brxe-block FAQ-section-one__answer accordion-content-wrapper" role="region" aria-labelledby="brxe-wdoafa"><div id="brxe-btrluz" class="brxe-text FAQ-section-one__answer-content"><p>It depends on your needs. We have everything from simple, basic cabins for the &lsquo;simple surf life&rsquo; to large, luxury cabins with all mod cons, if the whole family is coming along. </p> </div></div></div><div id="brxe-mwhfld" class="brxe-block FAQ-section-one__item"><button id="brxe-lpbllt" class="brxe-block FAQ-section-one__question accordion-title-wrapper" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0" aria-controls="brxe-pgtnph"><h3 id="brxe-fdlgre" class="brxe-heading FAQ-section-one__answer-heading">What is the best time of year for a surfing holiday in Hvide Sande?</h3><div id="brxe-dobksv" class="brxe-div FAQ-section-one__answer-icon-wrapper"><i id="brxe-vvbbfx" class="fas fa-plus brxe-icon FAQ-section-one__answer-icon"></i></div></button><div id="brxe-pgtnph" class="brxe-block FAQ-section-one__answer accordion-content-wrapper" role="region" aria-labelledby="brxe-fdlgre"><div id="brxe-rptrxw" class="brxe-text FAQ-section-one__answer-content"><p>It depends on your ability and preference.
